```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- read_excel("ex-score.xlsx")
scores <- df$Score
notes  <- df$Note
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r desc-stats}
desc <- data.frame(
  Statistic = c("Minimum", "Q1", "Median", "Q3", "Maximum", "Mean"),
  Value     = c(
    min(scores),
    quantile(scores, 0.25),
    median(scores),
    quantile(scores, 0.75),
    max(scores),
    round(mean(scores), 2)
  )
)
knitr::kable(desc, align = c("l", "r"), caption = "Score Distribution Summary")
```

## Score Distribution

```{r boxplot, fig.width=5, fig.height=4, fig.align='center'}
ggplot(df, aes(x = "", y = Score)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#4472C4", colour = "#2F5496",
               outlier.colour = "#C00000", outlier.size = 2) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, colour = "#2F5496") +
  labs(title = "Ex. 1 Score Distribution",
       x = NULL, y = "Score (0–100)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
```

## Submissions Summary

```{r summary-table}
total   <- nrow(df)
missing <- sum(notes == "Missing")
late    <- sum(notes == "Late Submission")
plagiar <- sum(notes == "Plagiarism")
inc_fmt <- sum(notes %in% c("Incorrect Internal Format",
                             "Incorrect File Name/Format"))
submitted <- total - missing

smry <- data.frame(
  Category = c("Total Students (Roster)",
               "Submitted",
               "Missing",
               "Late Submission",
               "Incorrect Format",
               "Plagiarism"),
  Count = c(total, submitted, missing, late, inc_fmt, plagiar)
)
knitr::kable(smry, align = c("l", "r"), caption = "Submission Status Summary")
```
